The ONLY input is the exact 1536x1024 Soyo LISTENING apricot mother already marked for this same-canvas selection. Keep the entire canvas and every existing deliberately marked pixel at its actual coordinates; this is a second-step mask conversion, not a new silhouette or shadow.
Keep ONLY the ALREADY DELIBERATELY PURE-WHITE small original receiving/contact marks WHITE and make EVERY other pixel BLACK. Preserve all marked local groups; do not drop the tiny seat/book groups just because the neighboring linen is naturally pale.

These neighborhoods identify existing marks, NOT rectangles or new white shapes to paint. Follow only actual already-white contours at their original positions. Every unmarked natural bright linen, curtains/clouds, flower/lamp/cup, pillow/throw, floor/rug solar patch or lamp reflection, wood grain and unrelated furniture shade also become black. No natural room highlight is a contact selection.
Output exactly ONE opaque 1536x1024 black PNG with only those same few local white receiver groups. Thin antialias grey only at existing edges. No new shadow/person, whole cushion, oval/rectangle, text, labels, arrows, grid, checker, crop, resize, zoom, shift or recentering. This will select unchanged original mother RGB once through MAX(F,S) as a FIXED included joint layer, never a portable independent caster.
